result.summary: The intersection lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and ADA-compliant curb ramps. While sidewalks are present, the wide, unmarked roadway and poor pavement quality create a hostile environment for pedestrians attempting to cross.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at this intersection, leaving pedestrians without a designated or protected path across the street.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: The intersection is controlled by vehicle traffic lights but lacks dedicated pedestrian signal heads, making it difficult for pedestrians to know when it is safe to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Traffic light pole on the corner

hazards.name: Degraded Road Surface
hazards.description: The asphalt in the intersection is cracked and uneven, presenting potential trip hazards for pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks on all legs of the intersection to define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions to reduce the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The intersection is characterized by a wide expanse of asphalt with embedded streetcar tracks and a complete lack of marked pedestrian crossings. While sidewalks are present, the poor pavement condition and long unprotected crossing distances create a hostile environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Embedded Streetcar Tracks
hazards.description: Metal tracks embedded in the roadway create uneven surfaces that are tripping hazards for pedestrians and can trap bicycle wheels.
hazards.location_in_image: Spanning across the foreground and center of the intersection.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crosswalks
hazards.description: The absence of painted crosswalks at this wide intersection fails to provide a designated path for pedestrians or a visual cue for drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire roadway area in the foreground.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Significant cracking and potholes in the asphalt increase the risk of trips and falls, especially near the tracks.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way and improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Islands
interventions.description: Construct raised islands in the center of the wide roadway to reduce exposure time and provide a safe waiting area.

interventions.title: Pavement Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair and smooth the roadway surface, particularly around the streetcar tracks, to eliminate tripping hazards.
